title: Enterprise cost center pool to paid overage
summary: Enable the AI Innovation cost-center pool and show excess Enterprise usage rolling into metered budgets.

steps.title: Use the AI Innovation pool
steps.description: Alice consumes all 38,900 included credits available to the AI Innovation cost center.
steps.expected: The cost-center included pool reaches 100%, while paid overage remains $0.

steps.title: Roll into paid overage
steps.description: Alice consumes 2,400 more AI credits after the AI Innovation pool is exhausted.
steps.expected: The event is accepted as $24 of paid overage and the AI team metered budget reaches 80%, crossing its 75% threshold.
